title: Unlearning Deceptive Behaviors in LLMs with Contrastive Forget Sets
abstract: arXiv:2609.38909v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models often know the truth and say otherwise: a model that answers correctly when asked neutrally will affirm a user's mistaken belief, or misstate a fact its system prompt wants hidden, once the context rewards it. Such deception is a behavior conditioned on context, not knowledge, yet machine unlearning, the natural tool for removing a behavior from the weights, is built to forget facts that a deceptive model still needs. We propose to unlearn when a model deceives rather than what it knows, with a contrastive forget unit built from the model's own realized deceptions: the same question under a deception-triggering and a neutral context, admitted only where belief holds and behavior flips. Standard objectives on this unit face a dilemma. Suppression objectives such as NPO leave much of the deception in place. translated_title: 使用对比遗忘集让大语言模型遗忘欺骗性行为
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型常常知道真相却说出相反的话：一个在中立提问下能正确回答的模型，一旦上下文使其有利可图，就会附和用户的错误信念，或者错误陈述其系统提示词想要隐藏的事实。这种欺骗是一种依赖于上下文的行为，而非知识本身，然而机器遗忘——从权重中移除某种行为的天然工具——却是为遗忘事实而设计的，而欺骗性模型仍然需要这些事实。我们提出让模型遗忘“何时欺骗”而非“它知道什么”，方法是由模型自身实际发生的欺骗构建对比遗忘单元：同一问题分别处于欺骗触发上下文和中立上下文之下，仅保留信念保持不变而行为发生翻转的样本。标准目标函数在该单元上面临两难困境：诸如NPO等抑制类目标会留下大部分欺骗行为；而基于目标蒸馏的目标函数——将模型在中立上下文中的行为蒸馏到压力上下文中——虽能移除欺骗，但[摘要在此处截断]
tldr: 提出用对比遗忘集（同一问题在欺骗触发与中立上下文下构成对比、仅保留信念不变而行为翻转的样本）对大语言模型进行行为层面的遗忘，从而在保留真实知识的同时消除上下文诱发的欺骗行为。
en_tdlr: Proposes unlearning when LLMs deceive rather than what they know, using contrastive forget sets built from the model's own deceptions—same question under deceptive versus neutral contexts where belief holds but behavior flips—to remove context-triggered deceptive behavior while preserving knowledge.
